items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ingrid Bergman. Antonioni. It just doesn't stop.

ctx.x: Jimmy’s gone. I went through the whole thing. Janet Thurlow is one of the oldest friends I have. She was one of the ones responsible for me being in Hamp’s band, his wife. We were roommates, way – God – before electricity. Janet’s from Seattle. Jimmy Cleveland. Floyd Standifer’s gone. Charlie Taylor’s gone. Amputated leg, gone. It’s just terrifying. Billy Johnson. All the cats I started with. In two years I lost 139 friends. Ingrid Bergman. Antonioni. It just doesn’t stop. Luther. Billy Preston. It’s…
